**Service**
Which service needs LDAP/SSO? (e.g. Grafana, ntopng, OpenSearch Dashboards)

**Current behavior**
How does authentication work now? (e.g. local auth, no auth, hardcoded creds)

**Desired authentication method**
- [ ] LDAP / AD
- [ ] OAuth2 / OIDC (Google, GitHub, etc.)
- [ ] SAML
- [ ] Traefik forward auth (already available)
- [ ] Other:

**Does this service already support LDAP natively?**
- [ ] Yes, but config is missing
- [ ] No, would need a proxy/auth middleware
- [ ] Not sure

**Additional context**
Add any relevant config snippets, docs links, or use case details.
